_about: Public-domain Joseph Longking, Methodist Episcopal Sunday-school writer, for the Word Hoard: Questions on the Gospels, Notes Illustrative and Explanatory on the Holy Gospels, Sunday School Tracts, and Notes on the Epistles to the Galatians and Ephesians. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 119 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
